when: computed from the earlier dev/hidden/transfer runs on openai/gpt-5.4-mini, while the confirmatory arms were still executing and before any confirmatory RESULT.json existed
unit_of_analysis: family-level mean utility, paired between arms
reading: the plausible true effect of ctes over full on utility is around 0.15 to 0.25 points, and at twenty families the design can only detect about 0.24. H2 was therefore likely to come out inconclusive for want of families rather than for want of an effect, exactly as it did on the earlier splits.
consequence: the confirmatory split is extended from 20 to 40 families before any confirmatory result is read; see Amendment 2 of PRE_REGISTRATION.md
note_on_H1: the mechanism hypothesis needs no power argument: hearsay receipts differ between arms by one to two orders of magnitude, not by a fraction of a standard deviation
